name: HyperFrames 单文件渲染
description: 【自定义】直接把一段 HTML 合成脚本交给 HyperFrames CLI 渲染成片，不经过 BRIEF.md 与工作流路由；成片由工作流驱动时使用「HyperFrames 渲染」节点
execCode:
import json
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

# Get inputs
html_content = inputs.get('html_content', '')
html_file = inputs.get('html_file', '')

# Get config
output_format = config.get('output_format', 'mp4')
width = config.get('width', 1920)
height = config.get('height', 1080)
fps = config.get('fps', 30)
quality = config.get('quality', 'high')

# Quality presets
quality_map = {
    'low': {'bitrate': '2M', 'preset': 'ultrafast'},
    'medium': {'bitrate': '5M', 'preset': 'fast'},
    'high': {'bitrate': '10M', 'preset': 'medium'},
    'ultra': {'bitrate': '20M', 'preset': 'slow'}
}
quality_settings = quality_map.get(quality, quality_map['high'])

# Create temp directory for HyperFrames files
temp_dir = Path(cache_dir) / 'hyperframe_temp'
temp_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

# Save HTML content
html_path = temp_dir / 'composition.html'
if html_file and os.path.exists(html_file):
    with open(html_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        html_content = f.read()

with open(html_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(html_content)

# Output video path
output_video = Path(cache_dir) / f'hyperframe_output.{output_format}'

# Build HyperFrames render command
try:
    # Try using HyperFrames CLI
    cmd = [
        'npx', 'hyperframes', 'render',
        str(html_path),
        '--output', str(output_video),
        '--width', str(width),
        '--height', str(height),
        '--fps', str(fps),
        '--format', output_format
    ]
    
    result = subprocess.run(
        cmd,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=300,
        cwd=task_dir
    )
    
    if result.returncode != 0:
        # Fallback: try alternative command
        cmd = [
            'npx', '@anthropic-ai/hyperframes', 'render',
            str(html_path),
            '--output', str(output_video)
        ]
        result = subprocess.run(
            cmd,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=300,
            cwd=task_dir
        )
    
    if result.returncode == 0 and output_video.exists():
        produced['video'] = str(output_video)
        produced['text'] = f'Rendered successfully: {output_video}'
        produced['json'] = json.dumps({
            'success': True,
            'output': str(output_video),
            'width': width,
            'height': height,
            'fps': fps,
            'format': output_format
        }, ensure_ascii=False)
    else:
        error_msg = result.stderr or result.stdout or 'Unknown error'
        produced['text'] = f'Render failed: {error_msg}'
        produced['json'] = json.dumps({
            'success': False,
            'error': error_msg,
            'html_path': str(html_path)
        }, ensure_ascii=False)
        
except FileNotFoundError:
    produced['text'] = 'HyperFrames CLI not found. Please install: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/hyperframes'
    produced['json'] = json.dumps({
        'success': False,
        'error': 'HyperFrames CLI not installed',
        'html_path': str(html_path),
        'install_command': 'npm install -g @anthropic-ai/hyperframes'
    }, ensure_ascii=False)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    produced['text'] = 'Render timeout (300s). Try reducing video length or complexity.'
    produced['json'] = json.dumps({
        'success': False,
        'error': 'Timeout after 300s',
        'html_path': str(html_path)
    }, ensure_ascii=False)
except Exception as e:
    produced['text'] = f'Render error: {str(e)}'
    produced['json'] = json.dumps({
        'success': False,
        'error': str(e),
        'html_path': str(html_path)
    }, ensure_ascii=False)
